definitions.noun: A powerful motor vehicle with large, heavy treads or wheels, used for pulling farm machinery or other heavy loads.

vietnamese.noun: Máy kéo / Xe máy cày

examples: The farmer used the tractor to till the soil before planting seeds for spring.
A rusty tractor was visible through the half-open barn door.

definitions.verb: To control or influence a person or situation cleverly, skillfully, or unscrupulously; to handle or operate something with skill.

vietnamese.verb: Thao túng, điều khiển, vận dụng

examples: As a politician, he knows how to manipulate public opinion to his advantage.
The technician showed her how to manipulate the controls of the complex machinery.

definitions.adjective: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

vietnamese.adjective: Thực dụng

examples: She took a pragmatic approach to solving the budget issues by focusing on immediate needs rather than long-term ideals.
In business, a pragmatic strategy is often more successful than one based strictly on fixed theories.

definitions.verb: To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution.

vietnamese.verb: Bãi bỏ, hủy bỏ

examples: The government voted to abolish the outdated tax law to encourage economic growth.
Many activists have campaigned for years to abolish the death penalty worldwide.

definitions.noun: The feeling of being annoyed or less confident because you cannot achieve what you want, or the act of preventing something from being successful.

vietnamese.noun: Sự thất vọng, sự nản lòng, sự làm hỏng

examples: He shook his head in frustration when the computer crashed again.
The teacher confirmed widespread frustration with the lack of up-to-date textbooks.
I could sense his frustration at not being able to help his friend.

definitions.adjective: No longer produced or used, often because it has been replaced by something newer, better, or more fashionable.
definitions.transitive verb: No longer produced or used, often because it has been replaced by something newer, better, or more fashionable.

vietnamese.adjective: Lỗi thời, không còn sử dụng
vietnamese.transitive verb: Lỗi thời, không còn sử dụng

New technology can render even the most advanced computer systems obsolete within a few years.

definitions.adjective: Of only moderate or ordinary quality; neither good nor bad; barely adequate.

vietnamese.adjective: Tầm thường

examples: The movie had a great cast, but the plot was mediocre and predictable.
Despite his potential, he remained a mediocre student because he lacked a strong work ethic.

definitions.adjective: Stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt; also used to describe graphic depictions of nudity or violence.

vietnamese.adjective: Rõ ràng, dứt khoát, chi tiết

The film was given an R rating due to its explicit scenes of violence.

definitions.adjective: Having a fluffy or soft texture; (of an image or sound) not clear, blurred, or distorted; (of a person's mind or ideas) confused or not clearly thought out.

vietnamese.adjective: Mờ nhạt, có lông tơ, không rõ nét

examples: The photograph was so fuzzy that I couldn't recognize anyone in it.
She stroked the baby's fuzzy head and smiled.
My head feels a little fuzzy this morning because I didn't get enough sleep.

definitions.verb: To make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent; to reduce the strength, force, or value of something by adding something else.
definitions.adjective: To make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent; to reduce the strength, force, or value of something by adding something else.

vietnamese.adjective: Pha loãng, làm mất chất, làm giảm bớt

examples: You should dilute the concentrated juice with water before drinking it.
The company’s decision to issue more stock will dilute the value of existing shares.

definitions.adjective: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief and to the point.

vietnamese.adjective: Ngắn gọn, súc tích

examples: The witness gave a concise account of the accident to the police.
Make your answers as clear and concise as possible to save time during the exam.

definitions.noun: A store that sells prepared foods such as cooked meats, cheeses, and salads, or the food items themselves.

vietnamese.noun: Cửa hàng thực phẩm chế biến sẵn (đồ nguội)

examples: Your morning routine might include a stop at the delicatessen for a toasted bagel.
Sliced cold meats from the delicatessen counters are believed to have been the source of the infection.

definitions.adjective: Providing or relating to views of impressive or beautiful natural scenery; also relating to stage scenery or theatrical representation.

vietnamese.adjective: Thuộc về phong cảnh, có phong cảnh đẹp
